comment: What tools/interop/interop.mjs needs that is particular to this repo: the mock GENESIS's answer per path (under --base-url http://127.0.0.1:<port>; built from the documented shapes, as packages/client/test/recorded.ts, since the Regionaldatenbank serves nothing without an account), how many tools the server lists, and the calls with what each must answer. The download is answered with its CSV as it is (the server reads a bare file as well as a ZIP). env gives both servers a test token, so neither reads a credentials file; authToken starts the HTTP server with a bearer token, which it requires.
